shortDescription: Restore Files and Folders from Cohesity Protection Jobs

options.name: backup_timestamp
options.description: protection run timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM format to use as source for the Restore operation. If not specified, the most recent timestamp is used

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in one of two formats - username@domain or Domain/username (will be deprecated in future).

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Specifies the name of Vcenter where file is located.

options.name: file_names
options.description: Array of Files and Folders to restore

options.name: name
options.description: Descriptor to assign to the Recovery Job.  The Recovery Job name will consist of the job_name:name format.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Should the restore operation overwrite the files or folders if they exist.

options.name: preserve_attributes
options.description: Should the restore operation maintain the original file or folder attributes

options.name: restore_location
options.description: Alternate location to which the files will be restored

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Recovery Job. (C)present a recovery job will be created and started. (C)absent is currently not implemented

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the Vcenter virtual machine, from where the files are located. Required if the environment is VMware.

options.name: vm_password
options.description: Password of the virtual machine, where files will be restored. Required if the environment is VMware.

options.name: vm_username
options.description: Username of the virtual machine, where files will be restored. Required if the environment is VMware.

options.name: wait_for_job
options.description: Should wait until the Restore Job completes

options.name: wait_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes to wait until the job completes.
